postTitle: Can we take a moment to appreciate Scott?
postSubject: Honestly though he went from working at a Dollar General, to becoming an Author and Director (with help from Gil and Kira of course), developer, to owning one of the biggest (video game) franchises in the world. That takes a lot of hard work. And then when he owns a million dollar franchise alone, what does he do? He donates it to charity. I honestly cannot believe he is an actual human. And I hate how people hate on him for milking the series when he's not. He made a good game with a great storyline and a... Decent... Community. And then people demanded more. I mean people are already asking for FNAF 5. He's not milking it; he's being a good guy and giving his fans what they want (Everything except answers.) Seriously. We need to appreciate him more. We need to be less ''notice me senpai'' and more ''let's notice senpai''. Thank you so much Scott for giving me a year and a half of joy and interest and something to always keep me thinking. And thank you for doing a good thing and donating it. You're helping so many lives.
